purpose: Hero for informational landing pages: mono eyebrow, large all-caps headline, a lede and one or two CTAs on the left, with a square supporting image on the right at md and up. Used to frame a comparison or the integrations catalogue before detailed content.

variants.name: compare
variants.description: CompareHero: eyebrow, headline built from the competitor name, rich lede (bold sentence inside), two CTAs (primary and outline) side by side from sm; the image is a product screenshot with descriptive alt text.

variants.name: integrations
variants.description: Page-local header: eyebrow, longer headline, lede with a bold lead, a single full-width Talk to sales button; the image is decorative (empty alt).

headline.note: Compare: 'Reevo vs.' plus a competitor name. Integrations: about 10 words. Rendered as h1, uppercase heading font.

body.note: Compare: 50 to 74 words across seven competitors; integrations about 39. One bold lead segment is used in both.

imageAlt.note: Descriptive on compare, empty on integrations.

behaviour.note: Compare hero is a data-driven template: the competitor name (and intro copy) come from a per-competitor data object, not the component.
The image sits in the right column and spans three grid rows from md; below md it appears between the headline and the lede.

motion.reducedMotionNote: Static; the only motion is the shared button hover.

changes.change: vertical padding 40 / 48 (md) / 56 (xl); bottom padding drops to 0 at xl so the next section starts flush
single column: eyebrow and headline, then image (with 8px vertical padding), then lede, then CTAs
image column 5 cols from col 8 at md, 9 from col 15 at lg, 8 from col 15 at xl, spanning three rows; lede spans 12 cols at lg, 11 at xl
compare CTAs sit side by side capped at 400px; below sm they stack. Integrations button is always full width.
